text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Queen—! To claim that throne, you need 
all kinds of strength!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(In solitude, without slacking for a 
second, I have honed this power!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(――I've learned to take from others and 
make it my own strength!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(And now, for the future of myself and 
those who will inherit it!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Go for it, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "Behold my running! For I am—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
The successor to the "Empress"!! —Admire 
Groove.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Admire Groove!! Back-to-back 
victories in the Queen Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Sooo frustraaaating!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Being faster than 'Wind Spirit Magic' is 
just cheating, cheater!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...It was purely my own ability.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Grrr...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Admire Groove! You'd better run again next 
year!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I won't be satisfied unless I snatch it 
away with my own hands!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Next year, huh.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It would be nice if we could run again 
next year.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Still-san. I'll tell you as many times 
as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"It's not over yet." As long as there's 
someone I want to show a victory to.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Yes...

"What awaited Admire Groove upon her 
return in victory was—"

It was a victory celebration at Air 
Groove's family home.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Come on, I ordered a mountain of sushi for 
the guest of honor, so eat up, eat up♪

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mother... you've had too much to drink. 
Honestly... what kind of example are you 
setting?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Come on, can't you let it slide when it's 
a celebration? It's the greatest 
achievement since our school was founded, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure it's alright? Strictly 
speaking, I'm not exactly... an alumna of 
the school—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You're my student, so don't be so stiff 
with me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It's rare to see the teacher get so 
excited. They must be just as thrilled as 
if it were their own success.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Did you dislike that?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: No... it's not that I hate it, but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ... Yeah. I used to hate it back then.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
But right now... I suppose I feel a bit 
bewildered.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I could ever act like that. 
It's just not in my nature.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Still... I don't dislike being here.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "...I see. That's a relief, then."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
And so—what are your plans going forward? 
Any outlook for next year—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ......I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: While watching you conquer the Classics—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I will continue to elevate myself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Besides, we've already promised a rematch 
for next year.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I'm looking forward to it. I, too, will 
definitely go and claim the Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you two over there! Stop muttering 
with such serious faces! Alv-chan, come 
over here!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hey, Dura! Help me stop Mother!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.
Admire Groove is smiling.

At first, she seemed so precarious that I 
couldn't leave her alone, but now she 
looks so full of joy.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What?

I recalled the very reason I became her 
Trainer in the first place.
choice_data_list:
Looks like you don't need me beside you 
anymore.

Looks like you don't need me beside you 
anymore, huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Right, that might be true. However...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Haven't you forgotten something 
important? My contract with you is now—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: It should be valid indefinitely.
choice_data_list:
Well, I haven't really drawn a line, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Then there's really no reason to leave it 
out.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —That's all.
